retrievalProfile.description: A classic country music aesthetic featuring a seated musician with an electric guitar against a dark, textured blue backdrop with bold, overlapping orange slab-serif typography.
triggerTerms: bold orange slab serif on dark blue

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male musician in denim, seated and holding a black and white electric guitar. The background is a dark, mottled blue with a stone-like texture. Large, vibrant orange typography is positioned in the lower right quadrant, partially overlapping the guitar neck.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in denim contrasting against dark blue textured wall
Bright orange typography as a focal point against the cool-toned background
Horizontal guitar neck acting as a leading line through the center
Text overlapping the subject's instrument to create depth
coreInvariants: Subject wearing a denim shirt and jeans
Bold, heavy-weight slab serif typography in orange

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated on the left, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white pickguard of the black electric guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the artist's face, follow the denim shirt down to the guitar, and move right along the guitar neck to the large orange text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant is primarily negative space, filled with the dark blue texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Indigo and navy blue (denim and background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark, desaturated background and the highly saturated orange text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with rounded terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'j' and 'f' in the top line are tightly kerned to overlap slightly
The 'b' in the second line is scaled larger to anchor the composition

composition.position: above the second line of display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, colorful slab serif paired with a light, wide-tracked white sans-serif for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and blocky feel.
Provides the rounded slab terminals seen in the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a male musician with dark hair and a goatee, wearing a denim shirt and jeans, seated and playing a black electric guitar with a white pickguard. The background should be a dark, textured navy blue wall with a mottled, stone-like finish.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold orange slab-serif text in lowercase in the bottom right corner. Ensure the text is tightly spaced and overlaps the guitar neck. Add a secondary line of small, white, wide-tracked sans-serif text just above the second word of the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the background dark blue and textured?
Is the main text orange and slab-serif?
Does the text overlap the guitar?

mustRedesign: Avoid using thin or elegant serif fonts
Do not use a flat, solid color background
Ensure the text is not placed in a way that obscures the artist's face

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and large-scale typography
avoid: Floating text that doesn't interact with the subject

postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange text is lowercase
Verify the guitar neck passes behind or through the text area
Ensure the background has a mottled, non-uniform appearance
Confirm the denim shirt has visible seams and buttons
Check that the white subtitle is legible against the dark background
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated Musician + Denim + Dark Textured Wall + Overlapping Bold Slab Serif Typography
